3 employee pay statements could not be posted to bank because the employees' bank accounts are not set up in the system. Payroll batch ABJ-JUL-2024 completed with 3 errors. Set up bank accounts for the 3 employees and reprocessed pay statements.

title: Leave balance not accruing correctly — anniversary date calculation wrong
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.39 (HR/Leave)
Employee leave balance is accruing based on calendar year instead of employment anniversary date. Employee hired on 15-Mar should accrue from March but accrual starts in January. Root cause: leave plan type was set to 'Calendar year' instead of 'Anniversary date'.

title: Benefits enrollment not saving — mandatory benefit plan missing
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.40 (HR/Benefits)
Employees completing open enrollment cannot save their benefits selection. Error: 'Medical plan selection is mandatory but no plan was selected.' The mandatory medical plan was added to the enrollment requirements on 01-Jul but 134 employees had already started enrollment before it was added.

title: Position hierarchy not reflecting recent reorganization
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.38 (HR)
3 departments were merged in June 2024 but the D365 position hierarchy still shows the old structure. Workflow approvals are routing to managers who no longer manage those employees. Updated position hierarchy and reactivated affected workflows.

title: Worker termination date applied to wrong employee record
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.41 (HR)
Employee John Smith (ID EMP-000234) was terminated on 30-Jun-2024 but the termination date was accidentally applied to employee Jane Smith (ID EMP-000235). Jane Smith lost system access. Root cause: user selected wrong employee from a search result. Reversed the termination on Jane Smith and reapplied to John Smith.

title: D365 Finance performance degradation after update 10.0.41
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.41
After applying update 10.0.41, the AP invoice list page takes 45 seconds to load (previously 3 seconds). Root cause: a new index was dropped as part of the update migration. Microsoft confirmed via support case and provided a hotfix script to recreate the missing index.

title: User cannot access legal entity after role reassignment
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.39
After reassigning user 'aparker@contoso.com' from role AP_CLERK to AP_MANAGER, the user can no longer access legal entity USRT. Root cause: AP_MANAGER role does not include the USRT legal entity in its data security policy. Added USRT access to the AP_MANAGER role.

title: Finance Insights AI prediction not refreshing after data update
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.40, Finance Insights
The cash flow prediction in Finance Insights has not updated for 14 days despite new transactions being posted daily. Root cause: the AI model refresh batch job was paused during a maintenance window and not restarted. Restarted the Finance Insights refresh job.

title: Session timeout too short — users losing unsaved work
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.41
Users are experiencing session timeouts after 15 minutes of inactivity, losing unsaved work. The configured timeout is 60 minutes. Root cause: a load balancer configuration was overriding the application timeout with a 15-minute idle timeout. Updated the load balancer idle timeout to 65 minutes.

title: Environment copy — production data visible in test environment
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.38
After copying production to UAT environment, real customer and vendor names, bank account numbers, and financial data are visible in UAT. Data scrubbing was supposed to run automatically. Root cause: the data scrubbing package was not included in the environment copy pipeline. Added scrubbing to the pipeline and re-copied.

title: Subscription billing — renewal invoice not generated automatically
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.40
Annual subscription SBC-000456 expired on 01-Jul-2024 without generating a renewal invoice. The auto-renewal was enabled. Root cause: the subscription billing schedule end date was set to 30-Jun-2024 (one day before the expected renewal). Extended end date and generated renewal invoice.

title: Service order parts cost not flowing to service invoice
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.39
Service order SO-SVC-000234 consumed USD 890 in spare parts but the parts cost does not appear on the customer invoice. Root cause: the parts were posted to the service order but not added to the invoice lines. Added parts to invoice lines and re-invoiced.

title: Global withholding tax threshold not being applied correctly
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.41
Global withholding tax exemption threshold of USD 600 per vendor (1099 threshold) is not being applied. Vendors with total annual payments under USD 600 are still having withholding tax withheld. Root cause: the threshold check compares per-payment amount rather than cumulative annual amount. Submitted Microsoft support case.

title: Production route operation time not matching actual production time
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / SCM 10.0.38
Production route for FG-005 specifies 2 hours per operation but actual production is consistently 3.5 hours. Standard costs are understated by 75%. Updated the route operation time to 3.5 hours after observing 20 production runs. Recalculated standard costs.

title: Customer loyalty points not calculating on eligible transactions
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / Commerce 10.0.40
Customer loyalty program members are not receiving points for purchases made through the online channel. Points are correctly awarded in stores. Root cause: the loyalty scheme was not associated with the online channel in Commerce HQ. Added the online channel to the loyalty scheme.

title: Landed cost not allocating to correct inventory batch
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / SCM 10.0.41
Freight cost for shipment SHP-000234 (USD 2,400) was allocated to inventory batch B-20240601 but the goods belong to batch B-20240615. Root cause: the voyage was created with the wrong vessel arrival date, pulling the wrong batch. Corrected voyage arrival date and reallocated costs.

title: AP electronic invoice — XML parsing failure on special characters
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.39
Electronic vendor invoice import fails for invoices from vendor V-000789: 'XML parsing error at line 45: illegal character &.' The vendor's invoice XML contains unescaped ampersands in the description field. Implemented XML sanitization in the import process.

title: Cost of goods sold posting to wrong account after costing method change
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / SCM 10.0.40
After changing item M0005 costing method from FIFO to Standard Cost, COGS is posting to account 500200 instead of the standard cost variance account 590100. Root cause: the inventory posting profile was not updated for the new costing method. Updated posting profile for item group MATERIALS.

title: Customer credit insurance limit not enforced on sales order
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.38
Sales order SO-000890 for customer C-000456 (credit insurance limit USD 100,000) was approved for USD 145,000. The credit insurance limit check was not enforced. Root cause: credit insurance limits are advisory only in D365; hard enforcement requires a customization or credit management add-in.

title: Inventory marking — cost not transferred to sales order from purchase
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / SCM 10.0.41
Inventory marking between purchase order PO-000890 line 1 and sales order SO-000234 line 1 was set up to lock the purchase cost to the sale. After inventory close, the sales order used the average cost instead of the marked purchase cost (USD 45 vs USD 52). Root cause: marking was removed during a WMS work process.

title: Payment terms not defaulting correctly from vendor to invoice
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.40
Vendor V-000123 payment terms are Net30 but vendor invoices are defaulting to Net45. Root cause: the purchase order used for the invoice had Net45 payment terms (set manually on the PO). AP parameters configured to 'Use payment terms from vendor' override the PO. Updated AP parameters.

title: Financial period locked for one module but not another
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.39
The June 2024 period is closed for GL but AP is still able to post vendor invoices to June. Users expect the period to be locked for all modules. Root cause: D365 allows module-level period control. The period was only closed in the GL module. Closed the period for AP, AR, and Inventory modules as well.

title: Commitment accounting — encumbrance not released after PO cancellation
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.41
Cancelled purchase order PO-000456 (USD 34,000) still shows an active encumbrance in the budget control. The cancellation should have released the encumbrance. Root cause: the PO was cancelled but not finalized. Running the 'Finalize purchase order' process released the encumbrance.

title: Asset retirement obligation — unwinding discount not calculating
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.38
Asset retirement obligation (ARO) for site decommissioning (USD 2.1M, discount rate 5%) is not calculating the annual unwinding of discount. The ARO liability remains at the initial present value without periodic interest accretion. Root cause: the ARO accretion journal was not included in the period-end close process.

title: Trade discount not applying on back-order line creation
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / SCM 10.0.40
Customer C-000345 has a 10% trade discount agreement. When a back-order is automatically created from a partially shipped order, the back-order lines do not inherit the 10% discount. Root cause: back-order creation does not re-evaluate price/discount agreements. Added a custom alert to flag back-order lines for discount review.

title: Inventory value report not balancing with GL inventory account
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / SCM 10.0.41
Inventory value report shows total inventory of USD 4.23M but the GL inventory account (140100) shows USD 4.41M. Difference of USD 180,000. Root cause: 3 inventory adjustment journals were posted directly to the GL account without going through the inventory module. Reversed GL journals and reposted through inventory.

title: Subcontractor purchase order costing incorrectly including material cost
body:
Environment: D365 Finance / SCM 10.0.39
Subcontractor purchase order for service processing of item SC-001 is including the raw material cost (USD 45/unit) in addition to the processing fee (USD 12/unit). Total cost of USD 57 is correct but is being double-counted as the material cost is already in WIP. Root cause: the subcontracting route operation was set to 'Include item cost.'

title: Customer portal — invoice PDF generation failing
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.40, Customer portal
Customers accessing the self-service portal cannot download their invoice PDFs. Error: 'Report server is not available.' Root cause: the SSRS report server service stopped after an automated Windows update rebooted the server. Restarted the SSRS service and set it to auto-restart on failure.

title: GL close — retained earnings calculation incorrect for prior period adjustment
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.38
Year-end close calculated retained earnings of USD 12.34M but the prior year adjusted retained earnings should be USD 12.56M (USD 220,000 prior period adjustment posted in Q1). Root cause: prior period adjustments posted to the current year were not included in the retained earnings calculation. Applied the prior period adjustment manually.

title: Accrued revenue account building up — no reversals occurring
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.41
Accrued revenue account 120200 has accumulated a balance of USD 890,000 over 6 months without reversal. Revenue accrual journals were posted monthly but the auto-reversal was set to the same period (not the following period). Changed auto-reversal to +1 month and posted correcting reversals.

title: Goods in transit account not clearing after intercompany receipt
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.39
Goods in transit account 150300 has an uncleared balance of USD 234,000 from intercompany shipment IC-SHP-000123 (USMF to USRT). The goods were received in USRT 2 weeks ago. Root cause: the intercompany purchase order receipt in USRT was posted to a different GIT account (150400). Journal posted to correct the account.

title: Number sequence exhausted — vendor account numbers cannot be created
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.40
New vendor accounts cannot be created: 'Number sequence VEN-XXXX has reached its maximum value.' The number sequence was configured with a maximum of V-009999 and all numbers are used. Extended the number sequence to V-099999.

title: Financial dimension set not including all active dimensions
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.41
Financial reports using dimension set 'ALL-DIMS' are missing the newly added 'Region' dimension. The dimension set was created before 'Region' was added to the system. Updated the dimension set to include the Region dimension.

title: Vendor invoice matching — PO line closed before full quantity invoiced
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.38
Purchase order PO-000567 was automatically closed after receiving 95 units (95% of 100 ordered). The remaining 5 units were invoiced by the vendor but cannot be matched because the PO line is closed. Reopened the PO line, received and invoiced the remaining 5 units, then reclosed.

title: Month-end accrual for unbilled revenue missing from close checklist
body:
Environment: D365 Finance 10.0.40
The month-end close checklist for June 2024 did not include the step for posting unbilled revenue accruals. USD 345,000 in unbilled project revenue was not accrued in June. Root cause: the checklist template was not updated when the project billing module was added in April 2024. Updated the template and posted the missing accruals.
